title: AEW coordination marker
description: F9-A (ADR-0017; plan v4 D-31): .aew/coordination/marker.yaml, written once, create-exclusive and synced, under the control lock before the project's first thread, and never removed. Reads ask whether any thread exists with one stat of it; no write-side decision trusts it.

first_thread.description: The thread whose writer published the marker (on a recreated marker, the one that recreated it).

recreated.description: Present and true when a writer found the marker removed while a thread existed, and wrote it again: the original was deleted outside AEW.
